chunks: That is how We reward those who do good.

key_terms.الْمُحْسِنِينَ: those who do good / the righteous

ai.seo_question: How does God reward those who do good?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse underscores the divine justice that rewards the righteous, linking individual piety to the collective strength of the believers' ranks. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a promise of both worldly success and eternal bliss for those who maintain consistency in their good deeds, reflecting the principle of 'Jaza' al-Amal'.
